descriptor:
  id: weekly-group-inventory
  name: Weekly Group Inventory
  description: Reviews groups and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: policies
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_groups
    format: graph
    label: Load groups
    detail: Reads groups from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /groups
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - groupTypes
        - membershipRule
      scopes:
        - Group.Read.All
  - id: count_by_group_types
    format: transform
    label: Count groups by groupTypes
    detail: Counts groups by their groupTypes.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: '{{ load_groups.output }}'
      field: groupTypes
      buckets:
        - All
        - Security
        - Microsoft 365
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings
    detail: Generates a short groups report.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You review groups for Microsoft 365 admins. Be concise, factual, and
        conservative. Use only the supplied data.
      prompt: >-
        Total groups: {{ load_groups.output | size }}. Details: {{ count_by_group_types.output }}.
        Write a brief report: main finding, what to verify, next actions.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 200
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: weekly
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 604800
  result:
    summary: '{{ summarize.output }}'
    data:
      total: '{{ load_groups.output | size }}'
      breakdown: '{{ count_by_group_types.output }}'

descriptor:
  id: top-noncompliant-models

  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0

    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: devices
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_devices
    format: graph
    label: Load managed devices
    detail: Reads managed devices from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /deviceManagement/managedDevices
      select:
        - id
        - deviceName
        - model
        - complianceState
        - lastSyncDateTime
      scopes:
        - DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All
  - id: count_by_compliance
    format: transform
    label: Count devices by compliance state
    detail: Tallies managed devices by complianceState.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      field: complianceState
      buckets:
        - compliant
        - noncompliant
        - unknown
  - id: sort_by_last_sync
    format: transform
    label: Sort devices by last sync date
    detail: Orders managed devices by lastSyncDateTime.
    settings:
      kind: sort-by
      source: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      field: lastSyncDateTime
      direction: asc
      take: 10
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    detail: Generates a short managed devices report.

      system: >-
        You analyze managed devices for Microsoft 365 admins. Be concise, factual, and
        conservative. Use only the supplied data.

definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual

      breakdown: "{{ count_by_compliance.output }}"
      sample: "{{ sort_by_last_sync.output }}"
